Name: Animated Fish SVE
Author: Gervig91
Description:
[size=6][b][u]Animated Fish SVE

[/u][/b][/size][size=3]Adds animation for the fish of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url].

[/size][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/xiw4wPM.gif[/img]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/YYUjZWI.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/Z1UU4ch.gif[/img][/center]

[u][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][/u]
[size=3]Make sure to have the latest versions of the required mods:
[b] - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]
﻿[/url][b]-[/b] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿ (And of course all the mods required to run SVE)
Drop the mod into your Stardew Valley mods folder, load up the game. Enjoy :)

[s] There are 2 main files, one is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3578]More New Fish[/url] the other isn't. So make sure you download the right one for your game! [/s]
1.2.0 (and later versions) Now works with or without [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3578]More New Fish[/url].

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/pMVYpML.gif[/img][/center]
[u][size=5][b]Config[/b][/size][/u]
[size=3]There is a [/size][i]config.json[/i][size=3] in the mod folder where you can disable/enable each animation. Simply change "true" to "false", if you want to disable or reverse if you want to enable an animation.[/size]
[size=3]You can also change the speed of the animation in the [/size][i]content.json[/i][size=3] file, change the "AnimationFrameTime": x, to however long you want the animation to be.

[size=3]Some items have different versions, for example: "VoidEel" and "VoidEel2". [u][b]You [/b][/u][/size][b][size=4][u]can only have one of these enabled in the [i]config.json [/i]at one time[/u]. [/size][size=3]
[/size][/b]

[/size][/size][size=5][b][u]Extra
[/u][/b][/size][size=3]Link to my other animated fish mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5735]Animated Fish[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5845]Animated More New Fish[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7353]Animated Ridgeside Village Fish[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10913]Animated East Scarp Fish, [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11949]Animated Cowboy Life Expanded Fish[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6974]Animated Lunna - Astay Fish[/url].
